name: Generic Credential
description: A general-purpose verifiable credential for EBSI-compatible issuance.
summary: Credential type template for GenericCredential, a general-purpose W3C VCDM credential issued as jwt_vc_vcdm against the EBSI verifiable_attestation schema. The subject form has a single Subject group with the subject DID (id, required) and legalName. Used as the starting point when no domain-specific credential type fits.
